related.title: IEC 61850 GOOSE：重傳與相關遺失
related.titleEn: IEC 61850 GOOSE: retransmission and correlated loss
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學一般流量需400 µs/週期；保留300通過、700不足；增加保留時需同時重新驗IRT與一般流量需求。 profinet_cycle.csv、三區間守恆與負載回放 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 600 與變更 200 us/cycle、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching ordinary demand400 microseconds per cycle:reservation300 passes and700 fails; revalidate both traffic classes when changing reservations. profinet_cycle.csv, three-region conservation and workload replay Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 600 and changed 200 us/cycle, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學獨立模型漏接門檻0.005；p=0.1通過、0.3失敗；任何實際保護決策另需期限、網路與裝置驗證。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching independent-model miss limit0.005:p=0.1 passes and0.3 fails; actual protection decisions require deadline, network and device validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成週期1000 µs、保護100 µs、IRT保留300 µs；增加保留至700 µs，週期不變。 名義式 1000-100-300 = 600 us/cycle；變更式 1000-100-700 = 200 us/cycle。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 畫不重疊IRT、保護、一般流量三段並加總1000；以一般流量需要400 µs檢查是否能在餘窗完成。

合成觀察窗內三次傳送、各次丟失0.1；擾動0.3，暫假設獨立，並另設共同斷線對照情境。 名義式 0.1**3 = 0.001 all-missed probability；變更式 0.3**3 = 0.027 all-missed probability。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列三位元接收/遺失八種結果，總機率1；加入共同斷線機率c時需改為c+(1−c)p³，不能仍用p³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic1000 microsecond cycle,100 guard and300IRT reservation; increase reservation to700 with fixed cycle. Nominal 1000-100-300 = 600 us/cycle; changed 1000-100-700 = 200 us/cycle. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Draw non-overlappingIRT, guard and ordinary-traffic regions summing to1000; test whether a400 microsecond ordinary workload fits.

Synthetic three transmissions within an observation window with loss0.1 each, changed to0.3; assume independence and include a separate common-outage comparison. Nominal 0.1**3 = 0.001 all-missed probability; changed 0.3**3 = 0.027 all-missed probability. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate eight three-bit receipt/loss outcomes summing to one; common-outage probabilityc changes the result toc+(1−c)p cubed.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 畫出preferred、deprecated、invalid三段時間軸並標明新連線與既有連線的差異。
related.differenceEn: Draw preferred, deprecated and invalid intervals and distinguish new from established connections.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成週期1000 µs、保護100 µs、IRT保留300 µs；增加保留至700 µs，週期不變。 名義式 1000-100-300 = 600 us/cycle；變更式 1000-100-700 = 200 us/cycle。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 畫不重疊IRT、保護、一般流量三段並加總1000；以一般流量需要400 µs檢查是否能在餘窗完成。

SLAAC位址可先變為deprecated再失效；偏好期限與有效期限不是同一計時器。
教學基準：7200-1800 = 5400 s；對照：7200-900 = 6300 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic1000 microsecond cycle,100 guard and300IRT reservation; increase reservation to700 with fixed cycle. Nominal 1000-100-300 = 600 us/cycle; changed 1000-100-700 = 200 us/cycle. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Draw non-overlappingIRT, guard and ordinary-traffic regions summing to1000; test whether a400 microsecond ordinary workload fits.

A SLAAC address can become deprecated before becoming invalid; preferred and valid lifetimes are different timers.
Teaching baseline: 7200-1800 = 5400 s; comparison: 7200-900 = 6300 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
